name: p4-0305-pathlib-anatomy
title: Anatomy of a pathlib.Path Object and Path Transformations
spec: A two-panel anatomy diagram detailing how pathlib.Path deconstructs file paths and transforms them without string manipulation. Top panel (Single Suffix): Displays the path '/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml' divided into highlighted segments. A bracket spanning '/etc/kubernetes/manifests' is labeled 'p.parent'. A bracket spanning 'kube-apiserver.yaml' is labeled 'p.name'. Within 'p.name', a sub-bracket spanning 'kube-apiserver' is labeled 'p.stem', and a sub-bracket spanning '.yaml' is labeled 'p.suffix'. Callout annotations show: 'p.suffixes -> [".yaml"]', 'p.with_suffix(".bak") -> /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.bak', 'p.parent.parent -> /etc/kubernetes', and 'p.relative_to("/etc") -> kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml'. Bottom panel (Archive with Multi-suffix): Displays 'q = Path("/data/checkpoints/weights.tar.gz")'. Annotated callouts show: 'q.name -> "weights.tar.gz"', 'q.stem -> "weights.tar" (drops only the final suffix)', 'q.suffix -> ".gz"', and 'q.suffixes -> [".tar", ".gz"]'. Side box: Key Path operations: 'Join: Path("/etc") / "kubernetes"', 'Checks: .exists(), .is_file(), .is_dir()', 'I/O: .read_text(encoding="utf-8"), .write_text(...)', and 'Glob: Path("/var/log").glob("*.log")'.
alt: An anatomy diagram showing how a pathlib Path object decomposes file paths into parent, name, stem, suffix, and suffixes for single and multi-dot filenames.
cap: A pathlib Path breaks file locations into structured attributes like parent, name, stem, and suffix, eliminating fragile string splitting and slash joins.
